HDFC Mutual Fund schemes | Find which RTA holds your HDFC Mutual Fund folio | RTA investor portal. Step 1: HDFC Mutual Fund folios are serviced by CAMS as the registrar and transfer agent, so most HDFC Mutual Fund investors use the CAMS portal. Step 2: If your folio was opened with another AMC and later transferred to HDFC Mutual Fund, it may sit with KFintech instead. Step 3: Check your folio number on your latest statement or account maintenance form to see which RTA holds it, then use that RTA's portal.

HDFC Mutual Fund schemes | Download a consolidated account statement (CAS) | RTA investor portal. Step 1: Log in to your RTA's investor portal with your folio number and credentials; CAMS uses a mobile number or email plus PAN, and KFintech uses a similar login. Step 2: Open the statements or My Account section and choose Consolidated Account Statement. Step 3: Select the financial year or date range, and the folios to include if you have more than one. Step 4: Download the statement as a PDF and save it. Consolidated statements can be large, so request one year at a time.

HDFC Mutual Fund schemes | Download a capital-gains statement | RTA investor portal. Step 1: Log in to your RTA's investor portal and go to the reports or tax section. Step 2: Choose Capital Gains Statement, then select the financial year in which the units were sold. Step 3: Pick the file format you need: a readable PDF, an Excel or CSV for your own records, or the ITR-ready XML/XML schema file your tax preparer may ask for. Step 4: Download and keep the file with your tax records, since the same details are needed at income-tax filing time.

HDFC Mutual Fund schemes | Download the annual tax summary for income-tax filing | RTA investor portal. Step 1: Log in to your RTA's investor portal and open the tax or tax reports section. Step 2: Request the annual tax statement for the relevant financial year; it lists dividend income and realised capital gains per scheme. Step 3: Download the file, then use it to cross-check the figures in your income-tax return before you file. Step 4: Note that mutual fund tax rules changed for units bought on or after 1 April 2023, so check the holding period shown for each transaction rather than assuming an older rule.

HDFC Mutual Fund schemes | Where to find official fund documents and investor education | AMFI investor page. Step 1: AMFI's Investor Corner is the industry body one-stop hub for mutual fund knowledge, scheme categorisation and risk-o-meter explainers. Step 2: For scheme-specific charges, investment objective and risk details, read the official HDFC Mutual Fund SID, KIM and monthly factsheet for that scheme. Step 3: Keep the factsheet: it is the official monthly document that carries a scheme's expense ratio, benchmark and portfolio disclosures.
